claim: The front end's Component.Root has two children, layout and main; its pages are created by their first root LuaCall TransitionTo (sp_battle1, sp_battle2, sp_battle2_scenario, grand_campaign with its campaign_key); entering the three battle pages adds no global and no registry entry an enumeration can reach, grand_campaign adds 6 registry classes (OptionsTable and the multiplayer / game-core Pointer<> classes); the pages' own scripts keep private environments reachable only through LuaCall; TransitionTo('main') brings back the main menu and its pumping advert
notes: only the main menu pumps (napoleon.lua.update_callbacks): per-page probing needs a probe that transitions, reads and returns in one chunk, as fe_pages.lua does
